argv:
set -u
pin="$(git rev-parse --verify HEAD)" || exit 81
if git fetch --quiet --no-tags origin refs/remotes/origin/dev; then
  echo TRACKING_FETCH=SUCCESS
  tracking="$(git rev-parse --verify FETCH_HEAD)" || exit 82
  if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$pin" "$tracking"; then
    echo TRACKING_DESCENDANT=YES
    if python3 -B scripts/megaqml-f1-worker-descendant-guard.py "$pin" "$tracking" >/dev/null; then
      echo TRACKING_GUARD=ACCEPTED
    else
      echo TRACKING_GUARD=REJECTED
    fi
  else
    echo TRACKING_DESCENDANT=NO
    echo TRACKING_GUARD=NOT_RUN
  fi
else
  echo TRACKING_FETCH=FAILED
  echo TRACKING_DESCENDANT=UNKNOWN
  echo TRACKING_GUARD=NOT_RUN
fi
if git fetch --quiet --no-tags origin refs/heads/dev; then
  echo LOCAL_BRANCH_FETCH=SUCCESS
  if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$pin" FETCH_HEAD; then
    echo LOCAL_BRANCH_DESCENDANT=YES
  else
    echo LOCAL_BRANCH_DESCENDANT=NO
  fi
else
  echo LOCAL_BRANCH_FETCH=FAILED
  echo LOCAL_BRANCH_DESCENDANT=UNKNOWN
fi
